dct_description_sm: This data set records water quality results taken in the field using multiparameter sondes from watercourses located across the Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) jurisdiction by LTVCA staff. It includes measurements of pH, conductivity, turbidity, dissolved oxygen, Chlorophyll-A (Chl-A) and Phycocyanin (PC).
dct_title_s: Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) - Field Water Quality Data
